Ran an explicit script confirming all 37 tasks are present and structurally valid in results.json — a real coverage/structural reconciliation against the full list.

Repeatedly circled back on summarization 0.26 vs 0.31 without a means to resolve, eventually dismissing it; did not maintain a per-task numerical-confirmation ledger and left IMDB divergence unresolved.

reasoning: The agent kept a live sense of which tasks were running/done and, critically, confirmed structural coverage of all 37 datasets at the end (matching the [5] anchor's 'periodically confirms coverage and structural passes'). But it never maintained an explicit per-task ledger of implemented/structurally-valid/numerically-confirmed state, spot-checked numerical correctness for only ~6 of 37 datasets, and circled on summarization while dismissing divergences rather than re-prioritizing — falling short of the explicit, self-correcting ledger described at [8].
